name: HubSpot contact lookup
blurb: Wire a real third-party step: look each sender up in your own HubSpot and put what comes back in front of the prompt.
description:
A walkthrough of the external-step wiring against an API you already have, not an optimization example - the eight rows here are placeholders and the accuracy number means nothing. What it demonstrates is the machinery: a manifest that speaks HubSpot's own request and response shapes, a step key or a connection, fetching once per row and freezing the answers onto the dataset, and a prompt that reads them.

Replace at least one email with an address that exists in your portal before you fetch. The rest are meant not to resolve - a contact that is found and one that is not, in the same enrichment, is the whole point.
requires: A HubSpot portal, and at least one email in the dataset replaced with an address that exists in it
A HubSpot step key (a Service Key with crm.objects.contacts.read) pasted on the step - or a connection, once this server has HubSpot app credentials
